caption: A surfer falls off their board, colliding briefly with another surfer, before swimming away.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Two surfers on separate boards on a wave; no fall, no contact, no swimming. Unknown: whether fall, contact, or swim will occur within 3.333s.

INTERACTION: Fall requires loss of balance → contact requires proximity and timing → reaction requires sensory input → swim requires propulsion and intent.

PERSISTENCE: Wave motion sustains surfers’ trajectory; water resistance propagates motion; absence of collision or fall halts evolution of interaction.

INTERVENTION: If no fall → no contact → no reaction → no swim. If fall occurs without proximity → no contact → no reaction → swim may still occur. If contact without fall → reaction may occur, but swim remains conditional on intent.
